narrative.overview:
Matrimony balances the tactile warmth of fine cotton wedding stationery with the speed and precision of a modern mobile-first web studio. Every marketing, authentication, and workspace surface rests on a warm ivory paper ground (#FFFCF9) framed by soft blush tints (#F5ECE6), hairline champagne-taupe borders (#EADBD1), and deep espresso ink (#231B18) rather than sterile blue-gray tech neutrals.

Primary actions and ceremonial highlights are anchored in Editorial Burgundy (#8B2635), evoking traditional Vietnamese crimson wedding wax seals and silk ribbons without visual noise. For the reception-hall Live LED projection surface (/stage/[slug]), the system intentionally shifts into an ambient Dark Stage polarity (#16100E ground, #FFFCF9 typography, #C89D66 gold accents) so projected guest photos and wishes glow cleanly in dimly lit banquet halls.
keyCharacteristics: Warm stationery ivory ground (#FFFCF9) paired with crisp white cards (#FFFFFF) and blush accents (#F5ECE6).
High-contrast Vietnamese editorial serif headings (Playfair Display) paired with geometric humanist sans-serif body & controls (Be Vietnam Pro).
Pill-shaped action buttons (9999px) contrasted with softly rounded editorial cards (16px) and form fields (12px).
WCAG 2.1 AA compliant muted text (#6B5B53), warm amber badges (#7C531E on #FFF4E8), and botanical pills (#9B4A5B).
Calm, flat-by-default elevation relying on warm hairline borders (#EADBD1) and subtle warm-ink ambient shadows (rgba(35, 27, 24, 0.04)).

rules.name: The Warm Paper & Ink Rule
rules.body: Never pair cool slate grays or pure #000000 black with #FFFCF9 ivory. All neutrals stay rooted in warm umber (#231B18 -> #5A4B44 -> #6B5B53) so typography feels printed on stationery rather than overlaid on a generic SaaS template.

rules.name: The Verified Contrast Rule
rules.body: All small text (<= 14px) must meet >= 4.5:1 contrast against its immediate surface (#6B5B53 minimum on light grounds, #7C531E on #FFF4E8, #FFFFFF on #8B2635 or #9B4A5B).

rules.name: The Vietnamese Diacritic Clarity Rule
rules.body: Never tighten display tracking below -0.03em or compress line-height below 1.15 on Vietnamese uppercase/lowercase stacked accents. Always load vietnamese font subsets with display: swap.

rules.name: The Whisper Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never apply cold pure-black shadows (rgba(0,0,0,0.25)) or hard neobrutalist block offsets on editorial wedding surfaces; tint every shadow with espresso ink (rgba(35, 27, 24, ...)).

dos: Do use #6B5B53 (never #8C7A70) for muted text, captions, placeholders, and input icons on #FFFCF9 and #FFFFFF.
Do use #7C531E on #FFF4E8 for warm amber status pills and #9B4A5B (never #B56576) for Blush Botanical white-text pills.
Do wrap every page's primary content in <main> and attach focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#8B2635]/40 to every <Link>, <a href>, and <input>.
Do write natural Vietnamese B2C copy ("3 năm", "5 năm", "Đăng nhập nhanh bằng mã xác thực Email OTP bên dưới.").
Do pair role="alert" on error banners and role="status" aria-live="polite" on status/OTP confirmation banners.
donts: Don't leak engineering jargon ("Schema v2", "biến môi trường", "PostgreSQL + Redis") into customer-facing headings or subtitles.
Don't render fixed-pixel 500px canvas layouts or break dual-family (Nhà Trai / Nhà Gái) symmetry on mobile viewports (390px).
Don't invent fake testimonials, fake couple names, or unverified metrics on marketing or dashboard screens.
Don't use gradient text, hard offset shadows, or emoji icons in place of lucide-react stroke icons.
